summary: Sandbach United made a winning start to the 2026/27 season with a 1-0 victory over Stafford Town at home, with Tatters' first-half goal proving decisive. The Bach kept a clean sheet in a battling performance against a resilient visiting side, securing three points on opening day despite the goal coming from a somewhat fortuitous bobbler. Manager and fans will be pleased with the solid defensive display to kick off the campaign.
